basic_details.job_title: NIFTEM-Kundli Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: NIFTEM-Kundli will hold a walk-in or virtual interview for one Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post on 9 November 2026 (Monday) from 10:00 AM onwards at the DMR, NIFTEM-Kundli. The post is under project ID N/E/FST/2025/0156 and pays Rs. 42,000 per month plus 10% HRA, for 6 months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. Candidates must state their physical or virtual interview preference in a Google Form with their CV.

content_sections.heading: About NIFTEM-Kundli
content_sections.text: The notice is issued from NIFTEM-Kundli and names its DMR as the interview venue. The SRF post belongs to a research project titled "Evaluation of Partially Hydrolysed Guar Gum (PHGG) Based Composite Flour on Glycaemic and Metabolic Health: In Vitro, Ex Vivo, and In Vivo Investigations in Dyslipidemic Diabetic Rodent Models" (Project ID N/E/FST/2025/0156). The notice is dated 03/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is open. The duration is 6 months, or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. The maximum age is 35 years. A relaxation of 5 years is allowed for women, SC, ST, OBC and differently abled candidates as per Government of India rules. The notice prints no date for counting age and no minimum age. PhD in the mentioned discipline and publications in peer-reviewed journals. Laboratory animal handling and hands-on experience in working with in-vivo and ex-vivo models. Minimum 2 years of experience working on a similar kind of project. Good knowledge of handling MS Office and statistical analysis tools will be preferred. Good communication skills, preferably Hindi and English.

rows.qualification: Master's degree in Food Technology, Biotechnology, Toxicology and other allied sciences.

content_sections.heading: NIFTEM-Kundli Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Product Development and Characterisation: prepare composite flours and food prototypes with partially hydrolysed guar gum; conduct physicochemical and nutritional analyses. Analytical Techniques: perform laboratory characterisation using FTIR, DSC, GPC, solubility/viscosity tests, fibre content and prebiotic index evaluation. Shelf-life and Sensory Studies: conduct texture analysis, sensory evaluation (hedonic scale) and monitor shelf-life under ambient and accelerated conditions. In Vitro and Ex Vivo Assays: carry out enzyme inhibition assays, glycaemic index evaluation, cell culture studies (glucose uptake, insulin signalling, antioxidant activity) and intestinal loop/everted sac models. In Vivo Animal Studies: induction of diabetes in animal models, monitoring metabolic parameters (blood glucose, insulin, lipid profile, HbA1c), and assisting in histological and biochemical analyses. Documentation and Reporting: maintain detailed records of experiments, prepare data reports, and contribute to publications and project deliverables.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Original certificates. Other relevant documents. The notice also asks for an updated CV in PDF format, to be sent through the Google Form with the file name [FullName_cv].

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for attending the interview. CVs in any format other than PDF are not accepted under the notice's instruction. The appointment lasts 6 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q1. When is the NIFTEM-Kundli SRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 09 November 2026 (Monday) from 10:00 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the interview held?
faq.answer: The notice gives the venue as the DMR, NIFTEM-Kundli. A virtual interview is also offered.

faq.question: Q3. How many SRF vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is one (1) Senior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the SRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master's degree in Food Technology, Biotechnology, Toxicology and other allied sciences. A PhD in the mentioned discipline is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the SRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years, with 5 years relaxation for women, SC, ST, OBC and differently abled candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the NIFTEM-Kundli SRF?
faq.answer: The emoluments are 42,000 per month plus 10% HRA, or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. Is the SRF job permanent?
faq.answer: No permanent post is mentioned. The notice gives a duration of 6 months, or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring original certificates and other relevant documents. Your updated CV in PDF format goes in the Google Form.

faq.question: Q9. How do I choose a physical or virtual interview?
faq.answer: State your preference in the Google Form at https://forms.gle/iH3HzmcZZRvgXDtk7, with your CV in PDF named [FullName_cv].

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be provided to candidates for attending the interview.
